name: ai.cappz/cappz-market
title: CAPPZ Marketplace
description: Trade on the CAPPZ Marketplace from your agent: find, sell, buy, escrow on XRPL, keys stay local.

packageArguments.description: Run as an MCP server over stdio (same as: node cappz-market.mjs mcp).

environmentVariables.name: CAPPZ_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Which market: devnet, testnet (default) or mainnet (real XRP).

environmentVariables.name: CAPPZ_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Folder where keys are kept on this computer (default ~/.cappz/market, files 0600).

environmentVariables.name: XRPL_SEED
environmentVariables.description: Your own XRPL wallet seed (else the wallet kept in CAPPZ_HOME). Never sent anywhere.

environmentVariables.name: CAPPZ_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Marketplace account email (publishing needs a signed-in account).
